site.title: Senior Lecturer, Department of Computer Science
site.address: Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Computing and IT, University of Gujrat, Hafiz Hayat Campus, Gujrat, Pakistan
site.description: Computer scientist working on federated learning with heterogeneous clients, knowledge distillation and trustworthy AI. Senior Lecturer at the University of Gujrat; research collaborator of the Jožef Stefan Institute, Slovenia.

news: Generative and agentic AI for network intrusion detection: systematic review published in the International Journal of Information Security (JIF 5.0, Q1).
FedSight, a federated decision-support system for retinal diagnosis, published in Knowledge-Based Systems (JIF 8.0, Q1).
Adaptive dual-mode distillation for federated learning published in IEEE Access, (JIF 4.2, Q2).
Ensemble attention deep network for imbalanced silicon wafer defect inspection published in PeerJ Computer Science (JIF 2.9, Q2).
Two sole-author arXiv preprints on leakage-aware evaluation (intrusion detection and drone audio).
